First publication of the text used (SE colophon: 'Look Homeward, Angel was published in 1929 by Thomas Wolfe.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published before 1931 (SE colophon: 'Look Homeward, Angel was published in 1929 by Thomas Wolfe.'), so it is in the United States public domain. The edition's rights statement below says the same.
- Country of origin: the facts do not fix the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die died in 1938, so the text entered the public domain in each of them on 1 January 2009.
